name: icalendar-tzpair
instr:
**Meetings in our calendar feed show up at the wrong hour in Google Calendar and Outlook**

We publish a team calendar feed built with icalendar. Meeting times come from our database as
timezone-aware UTC datetimes (`tzinfo=timezone.utc`), which we set as each event's start and end.

Subscribers see every meeting at the wrong time. The weekly sync is at 07:00 UTC (09:00 in
Berlin), but Google Calendar shows it at 07:00 Berlin time, and at 07:00 New York time for the
New York office. Outlook does the same. The feed has:

```
BEGIN:VEVENT
SUMMARY:Weekly sync
DTSTART:20251007T070000
DTEND:20251007T080000
DTSTAMP:20251001T080000
UID:sync-1@acme.example
END:VEVENT
```

Our CI has a round-trip test: build the calendar, serialize it, parse it back with
`Calendar.from_ical` and check it equals the calendar we built. That test passes.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, somewhere under tests/ (say tests/test_repro.py), that fails on the current code because
of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
